en.title: Left Something in a Jeju Rental Car or Hired Car? How to Get It Back
en.desc: Returned your Jeju rental car and forgot something inside? Who to call, what to say, and how to get it shipped after you've flown home.
en.h1: Left Something in a Jeju Rental Car
summary: Call the rental company's branch where you returned the car — the number is on your rental agreement or booking voucher. Phone is faster than email.
Jeju rental cars are returned at each company's own lot near the airport, so the item is with that company, not the airport.
Booked through a site (Trip.com, Klook, DiscoverCars)? Its customer service can contact the company for you.

sections.h: What to tell the rental company
sections.body:
• Your name and booking number
  • The car's plate number and model, and when you returned it
  • Where in the car — glove box, under the seats, door pocket, trunk — and what the item looks like

Call before the car is rented out again. Jeju cars turn around quickly in peak season.
If you hired a car with a driver, contact the driver or the agency that arranged it. Keep the driver's phone number or chat until the trip is over.

Rental companies generally treat forgotten items as a courtesy and expect you to pay for shipping. If they won't ship abroad, Jeju Live proxy pickup can collect it from the company's lot and send it to you.

faq.q: Is there a central rental car lost & found at Jeju Airport?
faq.a: No. Each company handles returns at its own lot, so contact the company you rented from.

faq.q: The company says they found it. What next?
faq.a: Ask them to hold it, then either collect it, ask them to ship it, or submit a Jeju Live proxy pickup request.

zh.title: 济州租车、包车落了东西？怎么找回
zh.desc: 在济州包车或租车把东西落在车上？该联系谁、怎么说，以及回国后如何寄回。
zh.h1: 济州包车、租车遗失物品
summary: 包车：直接联系司机或安排包车的旅行社，行程结束前请保留司机电话或微信。
租车：联系还车的租车公司门店，电话在租车合同或预订确认单上。
通过携程、Klook 等平台预订的，可以请平台客服帮忙联系。

sections.body:
包车司机一般能很快确认车内物品。请告诉司机或旅行社：用车日期、上下车地点、物品放在车里哪个位置。

司机下一单可能马上就要出发，越早联系越好。

• 提供姓名和订单号
  • 车牌号、车型和还车时间
  • 放在车里哪里——手套箱、座椅下、车门储物格、后备厢——以及物品特征

济州租车是在各公司自己的停车场还车，所以东西在租车公司，不在机场。
租车公司和包车司机通常把遗留物品当作额外帮忙，寄送费用需要自己承担。对方不方便寄往国外时，Jeju Live 代领可以去取回并寄给你，可通过微信沟通。

faq.q: 济州机场有统一的租车失物招领处吗？
faq.a: 没有，各租车公司在自己的停车场处理还车，请联系你租车的公司。

faq.q: 对方说找到了，接下来怎么办？
faq.a: 请对方先保管，然后选择自己领取、请对方寄送，或提交 Jeju Live 代领申请。
